description: Loan ad claiming pre-approval and the best rates around.
content:
You're pre-approved! Claim your ClearPath personal loan today at the best rates around.

Rates 8.99%-35.99% APR. Terms apply.
notes: The ad is not a prescreened firm offer (no mention of one or of an opt-out), so 'pre-approved' misdescribes an estimate. 'Best rates around' is an unsubstantiated superlative.
